name: Marketing Campaign Analytics
description: Digital marketing campaign performance across channels and segments

executiveSummary.overview: 25 campaigns across 6 channels generated $1.47M total revenue on $242K spend — a blended 6.1x ROAS. Email continues to be the most cost-efficient channel despite lower impression volume.
executiveSummary.topCategory: Email channel achieved an average ROAS of 54x across all segments, far exceeding Search (5.4x), Social (4.8x), and Display (2.5x). Enterprise segment consistently returned the highest revenue per conversion.
executiveSummary.risk: Display advertising shows declining efficiency with $4-8 CPM yielding only 0.5% CTR and 2% conversion rates. Video campaigns require significant spend ($25-31K) with modest ROAS of 3-5x.
executiveSummary.opportunities: Retargeting campaigns show 10-16% conversion rates versus 3-5% for prospecting — increasing retargeting budget allocation could improve blended ROAS by an estimated 18-25%.
executiveSummary.recommendation: Shift 20% of Display budget to Email and Retargeting. Pilot Enterprise-focused Email sequences for Q4 Holiday — historical data shows 528 conversions on 6,600 clicks for this combination.

smartAlerts.title: Impression Outlier Detected
smartAlerts.description: Product Awareness Display generated 1.2M impressions — 8.3x above average. Verify budget allocation.

smartAlerts.title: Channel Dominance
smartAlerts.description: Email represents best ROAS at 54x — significantly outpacing all other channels.

aiInsights.text: Email campaigns achieve 54x ROAS on average, making them the highest-leverage channel in the marketing mix.
Enterprise segment generates 2.3x revenue per conversion compared to Consumer — premium audience worth deeper investment.
Display advertising CTR of 0.5% signals potential audience fatigue or creative staleness — A/B testing new creatives is recommended.
Q4 Holiday campaigns generated the highest absolute revenue across all channels — planning should begin 6 weeks earlier next cycle.
Retargeting conversion rates (10-16%) outperform prospecting by 3-4x — increasing retargeting budget allocation is a low-risk growth lever.
